tests: Blank or unattempted cases stay unknown rather than zero or pass
Thirty authored annotations replay without becoming external observations
Critical overreach cannot be averaged away by all other perfect ratings
Unknown dimensions, critical checks and absent evidence cannot settle a review
Versions, source hashes and undeclared cases are rejected before mutation
Answer revisions preserve prior text and review rather than inheriting pass
Reviewer disagreement keeps two original ratings and is never averaged
Identical reviewer labels cannot masquerade as distinct review
Adjudication requires a real recorded disagreement and preserves the original basis
Revised reviewer opinions retain earlier events and inconsistent history is rejected
Fabricated imported summary claims cannot grant comprehension or training decisions
Unicode and HTML-like answer text survive JSON while fixed fields stay bounded
Contradictory critical status or invalid scores fail without changing the original
scope: Manual assessment state, revision and provenance boundaries; no automatic Chinese grading, external reader result or scoring validity verified
